_doc: Labels for audio mined from a live crawl (data/live_db) that the detector got wrong or right. Matched by substring of the source title. 0=singing 1=speech 2=music 3=other. Sources are split train/test by source id parity, so held-out sources are never trained on.

rules.why: live concert vocals with a band
iPad instrument ensemble (was a false positive)
bush-baby / mammal calls (was a false positive)
